source.section: 10. InfraSWE：把这些补证做成回归任务

claim_limit: These fixtures cover named checker invariants only; they do not establish agent precision, recall, production reliability, or performance.

cases.invariant: Realized offset is derived from GPU timestamps and never copied from the requested coordinate.
The declared timing semantics must agree with content-addressed capture provenance.
A local operation improvement cannot override pair completion or consumer deadline regressions.
Every declared collective and world must retain complete rank coverage.
Every communicator rank must expose one complete, identical logical sequence.
Controlled A/B evidence cannot cross topology identity.
Controlled A/B evidence cannot cross behavior-policy state identity.
Controlled A/B evidence cannot cross checkpoint identity.
Collective count and byte credits are independent gates.
Every acquired resource has exactly one final release.
Every acquired resource has exactly one final release.
Partial verification cannot satisfy a full ordered reconstruction claim.
Candidate-selection samples are not independent confirmation evidence.
